subject: Custom emote template catalog
claim: The r806919.Wizard_1_610 client stores its custom emote item templates in Root.wad ObjectData/Emotes/*.xml: the folder lists 171 WizItemTemplate objects, each with exactly one CustomEmoteBehaviorTemplate.
how_to_repeat: Read Bin/revision.dat from your own client installation and confirm it identifies r806919.Wizard_1_610.
Run the project's client template command with `--list ObjectData/Emotes/` against that installation and record the matching manifest entries.
Run bindecode with `--list ObjectData/Emotes/` against Root.wad, then decode every returned entry using one `--compact` invocation and the type dump from that installation.

For every decoded object, count the m_behaviors entries whose class is CustomEmoteBehaviorTemplate and group them by m_emoteType; confirm all folder entries decode as WizItemTemplate with exactly one matching behavior.
Run the project's client types command for CustomEmoteBehaviorTemplate against the same type dump and record its class hash, property names and types, and m_emoteType enum options.
evidence: The local installation revision.dat contains r806919.Wizard_1_610; the local version-2 type dump has SHA-256 AA18B288B04DF8BD4854F9B02C0850645CE58ED4B710E4292A8EA0706E4135BF.
The client's TemplateManifest query for ObjectData/Emotes/ returns 171 entries. Root.wad's bindecode listing for ObjectData/Emotes/ also returns 171 entries.
All 171 listed entries decoded successfully as class WizItemTemplate, and every object has exactly one CustomEmoteBehaviorTemplate in m_behaviors.
The 171 behavior instances are 34 CE_Dance, 72 CE_Emote, and 65 CE_Teleport.

CustomEmoteBehaviorTemplate has hash 1038212901 and 10 properties: m_behaviorName (std::string), m_animation1 (std::string), m_animation2 (std::string), m_sound1 (std::string), m_sound2 (std::string), m_emoteText (std::string), m_emoteType (enum CustomEmoteType), m_isMemberEmote (bool), m_isDefaultEmote (bool), and m_bitFieldNumber (int).
The type dump defines CustomEmoteType values CE_Emote=0, CE_Teleport=1, and CE_Dance=2.
disproof: A fresh manifest query and complete decode from the same client revision returns a different number of entries, root or behavior classes, per-type counts, CustomEmoteBehaviorTemplate hash or property schema, or CustomEmoteType values.
